title.quote: On the Scalability of GNNs for Molecular Graphs
title.justification: Title as given at the top of the paper
title.value: On the Scalability of GNNs for Molecular Graphs

extractions.description: An empirical study of the scaling behavior of graph neural networks (message-passing networks, graph Transformers and hybrid architectures) on large collections of 2D molecular graphs, covering pretraining scaling in width, depth, number of molecules, labels and datasets, plus finetuning and probing on 38 downstream tasks, resulting in the MolGPS foundation model.

type.quote: We address this drawback of GNNs by studying their scaling behavior.
type.justification: The paper runs large-scale pretraining/finetuning experiments and reports measured scaling trends.

name.quote: structure-based architectures such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are yet to show the benefits of scale
